page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at top with page number at top left; a rule below it; a display heading block (chapter number, title, names) centred; then the body text in one column with a large initial C; a catchword-like word "cedat," at the lower right of the text is the last line.

main_text.head: LXVII. LEGAT AD DUCEM JULIUM BRUNSVICENSEM EPISTOLA.
main_text.p: Constitui, Deo juvante, propediem me itineri committere, ut Illustriss. Ducis Joh. Casimiri Palatini voluntati obsequar, & ut quacunque ratione fieri possit Legatio mea fœlicem progressum assequatur: Cum autem permulti nobis adversantur & dent operam ne res Ecclesiæ salutaris prosperæ & feliciter nobis cedat,

page.notes: The initial C is a large woodcut-style letter, read as "Constitui". The heading is set in spaced capitals and small capitals; the title line "LEGAT AD DUCEM JULIUM BRUNSVICENSEM" is a single heading. Some words near the line ends are faint or damaged: "prosperæ" and "feliciter" are read from the scan with some doubt; "Palatini" line-end hyphenation is printed as "Pala-tini". Marginal speckles are not text.
